turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: With sharp, worsening pain in your lower right abdomen that started suddenly it's safest to go to urgent care or the emergency room right away. They can evaluate you much sooner than we can. If your pain gets severe, call 911.

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Okay, yeah, that makes sense. I appreciate you being straight with me about that. Thanks for the advice, .
